claude authored frames (dummy content, no real screens), claude 2.1.286 shapes; F21d and F21e are 2.1.284's numbered
theme picker. `paint.py claude.txt <id>` paints one; `capture.py` regenerates observations.jsonl; frames_test.go
replays it. grammar: docs/terminal-observation-claude.md. frames marked _source follow the source; their placement
was not observed live.
header: === <id> w=<W> h=<H> alt=<0|1> <renderer> [bclip=<row>] [tclip=<row>] expect=<activity>/<interaction>/<notice>
        <composer> reason=<reason> rules=<id>[@top|@compound],...|none (decision order; regions default to bottom).
bclip drops the bottom region's rows above <row>; tclip drops the top region's rows from <row>; both mark it clipped.
rows: NN|<text> (NNN| from row 100). tags: «f» fg 153,153,153  «f2» fg 215,119,87  «d» dim  «i» reverse  «b» bold
«it» italic  «w» fg 256-colour 220  «g» bg 55,55,55  «/» reset  «/f» default fg  «/g» default bg  «o»/«/o» OSC 8 open/close.
X{n} repeats X; ⍽ is NBSP; ⟩ pads so the rest of the row ends at column w-2.
